name: flip-dots
title: Flip Dots
description: Electromechanical flip-dot board: two-sided discs flip edge-on in a column sweep. Built-in marquee, text, clock, wave, ripple, rain, Life, checker, wipe, sparkle, bounce, pong and snake patterns, a controlled value, and press-and-drag painting. Shaded disc or flat faces, in circle, square, rounded, diamond, hexagon, triangle, star or plus shapes.
